title: Providence House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The interior of the home is thoughtfully laid out across three levels, offering spaces for both private retreats and communal gatherings. The kitchen is a chef's dream, equipped with two Subzero refrigerators, a Wolf six-burner gas range with grill, and a Bosch dishwasher, designed for entertaining. Views of the Gulf can be enjoyed from the second-floor covered porch and the third-floor balcony, adding a touch of serenity to every moment. Each bedroom, including the master suite with its new bath and shower, provides a sanctuary for rest after a day of the seaside or poolside relaxation. The home is also outfitted with modern conveniences such as wireless internet, flat panel TVs, and a new washer/dryer, ensuring every need is met. Whether seeking a peaceful escape or a base for beachside adventures, this home offers an unparalleled experience in Rosemary Beach. Nestled just steps away from the shimmering sands and soothing waves of the Gulf, this newly renovated haven in Rosemary Beach offers an unrivaled blend of luxury and convenience. With its prime location south of 30a, it affords quick access to the beach, Main Street cafes, and the picturesque Western Green, making it an idyllic retreat for those seeking both relaxation and adventure. The home itself is a masterpiece of design, featuring pecky cypress ceilings, bright wood walls, and rustic barn flooring. This unique combination of textures is complemented by modern, clean bathrooms, ensuring a stay that is both comfortable and memorable. The inclusion of a separately rented carriage house adds flexibility for guests, making this vacation rental a versatile option for families and groups.
